notes: cand_target() compared enc_version >= ENC_VERSION; bumping to 15 would have silently dropped the v14 candidate-target rule for r13d (enc_version 14) and changed its moves. Pinned to ENC_VERSION_V14 (Python cand_ids already used a literal 14; Python pad boundary moved to NR_ENC_VERSION_V14).

The 16 columns are computed v15-style regardless of the version argument in both languages (NRel's Python path builds on E.encode(version=12)+encode_rel, so a version gate could not switch them; Rust never had per-version encoding). Only the measurement switch deck_v14 reproduces v14. c-series Python encoding (n_eff, v12) goes through the same helpers.

Cache key (report §3.1): Rust had no deck-content-keyed cache (trunk cache keys on scalar bits = automatically correct). Only Python _DECK_ROLES_CACHE needed a new key (known ids, unknown ids, unknown deck slots).

Python known_by port: card attribute known_by (Rust bits P1=1, P2=2) and player attribute know_bit. Python boards carry neither today -> computed as 'no known cards'. The Python-vs-Rust encoding oracle (rs_encode_oracle.py) lives in legacy/ and is not in the current suite, so there were 0 oracle boards to restrict. Proposal (not implemented): add known_by per card to record v5 'hidden' so Python can reproduce v15 exactly on boards with known cards (51% of decision points have >=1 known own-deck card, mean 2.9).
Apex uses the plain max over known-deck + unknown cards (report's recommendation); it over-reads by the chance the top card sits in face-down life.

Void in the local arena (seed 1680032, OP17-079 Luffy vs OP06-080 Moria) is an engine trigger-ordering defect, not the encoding: Brogy (OP17-092) / Dorry (OP17-085) on-play each play the other from trash; the field-overflow dialog makes the child's queued ON_PLAY resolve before the parent's remaining 'then you cannot play Character cards this turn', so they ping-pong until the 400-step cap. Reproduces with both seats v15; both seats v14 take a different line. A trial patch making effect play_card honour CANNOT_PLAY_CHARACTER did NOT stop it (restriction not yet applied) -> root cause is the ordering. Not fixed here (changes rules + goldens; out of scope). Proposed: separate WP to drain queued triggers only after the parent ability finishes, plus effect play honouring CANNOT_PLAY_CHARACTER; report §4 has the decision write-up (recommend (c): merge v15, fix in parallel WP).
Arena verdict withheld per CLAUDE.md (void > 2%). The 0.449 over 39 pairs is reference only; at 40 pairs the CI (±0.12) cannot resolve the ±10 forecast.
Training data: record shape unchanged, meta enc_version 15; existing waves (<=47) keep v14 (leaky) columns; with current windows all training input is v15 after 2 waves (48, 49).
